description:
You are a craft artist who sells handmade clothing through your WooCommerce store. Your product catalog has grown and you need to organize it with a proper category hierarchy for better customer navigation.

Perform the following steps in the WooCommerce admin (http://localhost/wp-admin/, credentials: admin / Admin1234!):

1. Go to Products > Categories and create a new TOP-LEVEL parent category:
   - Name: Apparel
   - Slug: apparel
   - Description: Clothing and fashion items
   - Parent Category: None

2. Create a CHILD category under 'Apparel':
   - Name: Tops
   - Slug: tops
   - Description: T-shirts, sweaters, and upper body wear
   - Parent Category: Apparel

3. Create another CHILD category under 'Apparel':
   - Name: Bottoms
   - Slug: bottoms
   - Description: Jeans, pants, and lower body wear
   - Parent Category: Apparel

4. Edit the product 'Organic Cotton T-Shirt' and assign it to the 'Tops' category (check the Tops checkbox in the Product Categories panel on the product edit page)

5. Edit the product 'Merino Wool Sweater' and assign it to the 'Tops' category

6. Edit the product 'Slim Fit Denim Jeans' and assign it to the 'Bottoms' category

Make sure to save/update each product after assigning its category. The parent-child hierarchy must be correct: both 'Tops' and 'Bottoms' must be children of 'Apparel'.
